name: Rackpad
description: Rackpad is a self-hosted infrastructure inventory and operations workspace for homelabs, small racks, network rooms, and lab environments. It brings racks, devices, ports, cables, VLANs, IPAM, WiFi, compute, discovery, monitoring, docs, images, labs, and an admin area into one clean app. On first start, open the web UI and create the initial administrator account. https://github.com/Kobii-git/rackpad https://rackpad.co.za/

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Persistent Rackpad SQLite database and uploaded content

variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.description: Application environment

variables.name: HOST
variables.description: Bind address inside the container

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Internal Rackpad port

variables.name: DATABASE_PATH
variables.description: SQLite database path inside the container

variables.name: MONITOR_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Background health-check loop interval in milliseconds

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Set to 1 when Rackpad is behind a reverse proxy

variables.name: TRUSTED_HOSTS
variables.description: Optional comma-separated public hostnames Rackpad should trust

variables.name: TRUSTED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Optional comma-separated public origins Rackpad should trust

variables.name: APP_URL
variables.description: Public Rackpad URL, required for OIDC and recommended behind a reverse proxy

variables.name: OIDC_ENABLED
variables.description: Set to 1 to enable OIDC sign-in

variables.name: OIDC_ISSUER_URL
variables.description: OIDC issuer URL

variables.name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: OIDC client ID

variables.name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: OIDC client secret

variables.name: OIDC_REDIRECT_URI
variables.description: Optional explicit OIDC callback URL

variables.name: OIDC_LABEL
variables.description: Label shown on the OIDC sign-in button

variables.name: OIDC_DEFAULT_ROLE
variables.description: Default role for new OIDC users

variables.name: OIDC_DEBUG
variables.description: Set to 1 temporarily to log OIDC troubleshooting details

variables.name: OIDC_ADMIN_USERS
variables.description: Optional comma-separated usernames that should get the admin role

variables.name: OIDC_EDITOR_USERS
variables.description: Optional comma-separated usernames that should get the editor role

variables.name: OIDC_VIEWER_USERS
variables.description: Optional comma-separated usernames that should get the viewer role

variables.name: OIDC_ADMIN_GROUPS
variables.description: Optional comma-separated group names that should get the admin role

variables.name: OIDC_EDITOR_GROUPS
variables.description: Optional comma-separated group names that should get the editor role

variables.name: OIDC_VIEWER_GROUPS
variables.description: Optional comma-separated group names that should get the viewer role

variables.name: OUI_AUTO_UPDATE
variables.description: Set to 0 to disable MAC vendor OUI auto updates

variables.name: DISCOVERY_MAC_SCAN_MODE
variables.description: MAC discovery mode: auto, neighbor, arp-scan, nmap, or off
